plugins.name: cladeon
plugins.description: Screen an AI vendor's artifacts against how they say the model was built. Catches "we trained our own model" when the evidence shows a LoRA adapter or a wrapper. Runs entirely on your machine; a consistency screen, not a lie detector.

skills.name: screen-vendor
skills.description: Screen an AI vendor's supplied artifacts (model folders, adapters, configs, deployment files) with Cladeon to see whether they are consistent with how the vendor says the system was built, or verify a .clade bundle a vendor sent back. Use when the user is doing AI procurement or due diligence, asks "did they really train their own model", mentions a LoRA/fine-tune/wrapper claim, or has a .clade file.
headings: Screen a vendor's AI claim with Cladeon
1. Make sure you are on the user's own computer
